description: This PHP file is part of a web interface for configuring MoCA (Multimedia over Coax Alliance) settings on a network gateway. It includes PHP code for retrieving current configuration values, handles form submission for user inputs, and incorporates JavaScript for dynamic UI behavior and AJAX requests to apply configuration changes.

methods.name: php_str_and
methods.description: Performs a bitwise AND operation on two hexadecimal strings by processing each character to avoid JavaScript's limitation on bitwise operations exceeding 32 bits.
